DURABLE CONSTRUCTION: Crafted from high quality clear acrylic, our ornaments are printed on one side with the festive design shown. Unlike glass bulbs, our ornaments are shatterproof, making them perfect for families with kids or pets. Hanging cord included. Dimensions 3.0" (7.6 cm) x 3.6" (9.1 cm).

FUN FOR KIDS, TEENS AND ADULTS: Suitable for all ages, these durable ornaments are great for accenting Christmas decorations, personalizing for loved ones, gift swaps, or just admiring. Perfect as holiday party favors, goodie bag fillers, team gifts, or anyone on your Nice list.

CELEBRATE THE MOMENT: From first kisses to first steps, immortalize them all. Crafted from high quality materials and featuring an image and text phrase of your choosing, our premium ornament is printed using vibrant high-quality inks, resulting in long-lasting saturated images resistant to fading.

GREAT FOR GIFTING: Our custom ornament makes a thoughtful thank-you gift, holiday bag goodie, gift tag, or surprise for any occasion needing a personal touch. Perfect for holiday gatherings, company parties, fundraisers, trade shows, team and corporate events.
